description: Reference list of countries/territories UNHCR tracks. Use this to map a country name to the `code` you pass as coo/coa in the other tools. Each item has: code (UNHCR 3-letter, USE THIS for filtering), iso (true ISO3), iso2, name, region, majorArea. Paginated — large list, raise `limit` or page through (response.maxPages).

limit.description: Rows per page (default 25; raise to fetch more at once).

name: list_countries
